info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Validates-v3-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Validation API provides a mechanism to verify the validity of event tickets. This endpoint allows consumers to check if a specific ticket is valid for a given event before entry. Typically utilized by event organizers, venue staff, and ticketing platforms, the API streamlines the process of ticket verification and enhances the event check-in experience. By integrating this validation service, stakeholders can reduce fraud and improve operational efficiency during events.

get.description: This endpoint is used to validate the details of a ticket to ensure it is legitimate and not expired. It accepts the ticket information as parameters and returns validation results.

requestBody.description: This request body is required for validating tickets. It should contain the necessary information about the ticket that needs to be validated.

200.description: The validation request was successful and the ticket is valid.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesReque.title: Ticket Validation Request Body
ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesReque.description: The request body for the ticket validation operation, represented as a string.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesRespo.title: Ticket Validation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket validation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result from the validation operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket after validation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the validation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the validation.

audit.description: Contains audit details related to the validation operation.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesRespo.description: Represents the response object for a successful ticket validation operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the validation record was created.
